# MacUpdate — Intel Mac version listing

- Original title: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood for Mac
- Source: [Original publication](https://robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood.macupdate.com/)
- Author / publisher: MacUpdate; comments by Enduser and StrictlyBagel
- Language / date: English; listing updated 2012-04-20; comments September–October 2011
- Access: Version metadata, description, and two reviews inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

The listing identifies version 1.1 as an Intel 32-bit application, gives an 827 MB size, and lists Mac OS X 10.5.8 as the minimum system. Its brief change note mentions minor bug fixes without identifying them. This helps distinguish the later Mac App Store-era release from the earlier port.

Enduser enjoys experimenting with tactics without time pressure, while StrictlyBagel objects to selling an old game at the asking price. The historical operating-system listing is not a tested statement of compatibility with present-day macOS.
